productConcept.name: Filum
productConcept.description: Archival digitization studio (drum scanning, Flextight, cine film, institutional), Amsterdam

color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Pages background #e5e5e5 (luminance ~229, well above 190 threshold for light register).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Heading font weight shift. h1 weight shifted from 300 to 500 (+200 at intensity 3). Syne font retained via Google Fonts CDN import. Heading letter-spacing at 0.06em preserved. Creates stronger hierarchical contrast between display and body.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) at intensity 2 (×1.3). All transition durations scaled: 0.2s→0.26s, 0.3s→0.39s. Produces a more deliberate, unhurried animation rhythm consistent with the industrial-craft register of the ash palette.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Container max-width tightened at intensity 2 (−15%). 921.6px reduced to 783px. Creates a more editorial, column-constrained reading experience.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Section-specific breathing room at intensity 3. Section paddingTop +32px (190→222px), paddingBottom +32px (50→82px). All other spacing unchanged. Airier inter-section rhythm.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement at intensity 3. outlineWidth set to 2px across all interactive elements. outlineOffset 2px on links and navigation. Improves keyboard accessibility without introducing color changes.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 3 (0.08em). Combined with uppercase text-transform. Nav height set to 64px (scrolled: 56px). Mechanical label register with deliberate horizontal spacing.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift applied to Background stratum paragraph. Added specific language about the physical materiality of #e5e5e5 — 'the grey of an object that has been made', powder-coated aluminum, industrial lacquer. concept_by_video.md generated with 3 video placements: hero-surface.mp4 (10s light migration), material-study.mp4 (10s material close-ups), workshop-ambient.mp4 (5s empty workshop).

consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover transitions 0.26–0.39s, motion system primary durations 0.26–0.39s. No >5× mismatch.
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav.json typography.fontFamily is 'inherit'; resolved from typography.json which declares Syne as --font-primary.
